name: Laza (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle with its base along the upper edge and its apex at the middle of the lower edge, charged with a red and white peliqueiro mask and crozier.
history: Municipal flag of Laza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its vertices at the upper corners and the middle of the lower edge
peliqueiro carnival mask with its mitre on the triangle
